findings.message: w7 śivāya is marked epithet: true, but its only gloss is 'to Śiva'. No note explains the name. The meaning 'The Auspicious one' (mw-shiva) appears only in components[0].sense.gloss, which is not visible text. The rubric's pass case is a note saying the name means 'the auspicious one'. This is a refrain word, so that note may already be in v1; it cannot be checked from this bundle.
findings.suggested_fix: If v1 does not already explain the name, add to words.w7.notes: en 'Śiva means "the auspicious one".' / hi 'शिव का अर्थ है "मंगलमय, कल्याणकारी"।'
